findings.fact: An existing build/native-install-tree is recursively deleted after path-link checks without checking an earlier owning inventory or refusing modified/unowned entries.
findings.trigger: A preexisting unowned file in that generated child is removed on ordinary prepare/reconfigure.
findings.requested_remedy: Establish retained staging ownership and exact unchanged inventory before deletion; refuse foreign or modified state.

findings.fact: Content and path guards run during preflight, followed by a separate unlink loop that does not revalidate file identity/content or parent binding.
findings.trigger: A file or parent replaced after preflight can be removed despite now being modified/unowned or redirected outside the checked prefix.
findings.requested_remedy: Retain filesystem ownership/bindings through deletion and refuse intervening changes; cover replacement and parent-redirection interleavings.

scoped_observations: Canonical product/project/target owners supply identities; channel namespace is distinct from release/build identity.
Inspected distribution code does not install runtime services/tasks, start a runtime, migrate Settings-owned user storage or add runtime health administration.
disposition: Root accepted findings; native owner history assigned remediation after actual efb merge. Static scope only, combined verification pending.
